We need to propose a 3-step retrosynthesis for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Let's parse: It's a para-methyl phenyl sulfonamide attached to a phenyl ring bearing a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (anilide). So overall: p-tolyl-sulfonyl attached to a phenyl ring which has a side chain: /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH (anilide). So we need 3 reactions: likely (1) sulfonamide formation (attach sulfonyl chloride to aniline). (2) amide coupling (attach aniline to α,β-unsaturated acid). (3) Doebner modification to form the α,β-unsaturated acid from aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid.

Thus retrosynthesis: target -> disconnect amide bond between carbonyl and aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So precursor: α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid attached to phenyl (c2ccc(/C=C/COOH)cc2) plus aniline (c3ccccc3N). Then step 2: disconnect sulfonamide: sulfonyl chloride (p-tolylsulfonyl chloride) + aniline (the phenyl bearing the side chain). Actually sulfonamide formed between aniline (the phenyl ring with side chain) and p-tolylsulfonyl chloride. So precursor: aniline (c1ccc(N)cc1 with side chain) and p-tolylsulfonyl chloride.

Step 3: α,β-unsaturated acid from aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) via Doebner modification with malonic acid.

Thus we need templates IDs. We can search for templates matching these transformations.

Search for amide coupling (carboxylic acid + amine). Use functional_groups_broken: aliphatic carboxylic acid, primary amines; formed: amide. Already tried but got empty. Maybe need to specify "amide" as formed and "aliphatic carboxylic acid" broken, "primary amines" broken. It returned empty maybe because template not present. Could try "amide" formed only.
